objective: Detect prospectively abnormal behaviour on Polymarket that may be compatible with informed, coordinated or manipulative activity, then verify these hypotheses from reproducible data.
rules: A score never names an insider.
Behavioural similarity, probable common funding and proof of common ownership are three different claims.
A swap service does not link deposits to withdrawals without its own record.
No future data in a prospective signal.
A rejected idea returns only with new evidence.
